description: Delete a thumbnail from a video (image and its player CTA). Type: 'start' (default, the cover), 'pause', 'end'. For 'pause', thumb_name is required and must be the exact file name — returned by panda_add_pause_thumbnail, or metadata.thumbId of the 'pause' CTA in panda_get_video_player_config. The tool checks the name against the video's pause thumbnails first and refuses (listing the existing names) when it does not match exactly.

thumb_name.description: Exact pause thumbnail file name (required for type 'pause')

name: panda_delete_thumbnail
title: Delete Thumbnail
